recommended.why: default on: the clean paired win read +38.22% prefill tok/s (CI +33.64 to +41.83%, bit-exact, 3 clean pairs), 17.0-17.5 walk against 23.4-24.2 layered on the plain install; TURBOSPARK_FLINT_CHUNKED_PREFILL=0 restores the walk
the Flint prefill chunk refuses TURBOSPARK_BATCHED_GEMV and TURBOSPARK_ROUTED_BATCH by name; an arm that sets either is a recorded refusal, not a measurement
the 2026-10-28 clean sweep read 96 slots at -14.2% (LOSS) and 8/32 slots NOISE, and 32/96 fail the 64 MiB memory gate; 8 slots is the memory fallback at equal speed (1.17 against 1.84 GiB peak)
